meta.coordinate: anchor = bottom-center of trimmed image; place feet on ground line
meta.note_scale: baby sprites are ~0.54x the height of other groups in source pixels; scale kids by age in game (e.g. 4yo~0.6 ... 15yo~0.95 of adult height)
meta.lookAge: baby|child|teen|adult|mature|senior - what the picture looks like; actual eligibility is decided by in-game age
meta.skinTone: 1=ขาวมาก/ขาวเหลือง/ขาวอมชมพู (lum>=220), 2=ขาวเหลืองนวล/สองสีอ่อน (190-219), 3=น้ำผึ้ง/สองสี (150-189), 4=แทน (120-149), 5=เข้ม (<120)

flags.brand: looks like a real brand/IP (remove before public release)
flags.noise: stray black specks on face (maybe moles/artifacts)

meta.eyeShape: narrow|balanced|round|closed|hidden - visual eye shape classification for continuity across life stages
meta.dyed_hair_note: Characters tagged dyed_hair (fancy colors or <60 bleached/gray/silver) are excluded from natural birth/aging unless selected manually or via future style/dye choices
meta.ageRange: [minAge, maxAge] - hard visual age bounds per sprite to prevent teens getting middle-aged sprites or vice versa
meta.bustFocus: { x, y, zoom } - pixel-measured face anchor (0..1) and zoom so circular portraits stay centered
meta.context_tags: Supports personality/vibe (cute, cheerful, pretty, haughty, handsome, bad_boy, quiet, strict, kind, nerdy, gamer, artistic, sporty, rebellious), body (chubby, muscular), archetypes (sia, sugar_daddy, sugar_mommy, jae, sor, khun_nai, khun_nu, uncle, aunt), wealth (luxury, middle_class, humble, street_working), and regions (isaan_vibe, north_vibe, south_vibe, central_bkk, thai_traditional, chinese_thai)
meta.look_impression_note: Outward impression tags (*_look) and occupation/archetype tags reflect visual appearance only and do not dictate inner personality.
